title: Measuring the Bean Plants

readiness.math: measuring height with a repeated unit; counting; comparing (tallest), and the difference between two heights (older)

intro.speaker: miriam
intro.text: Look how our beans have grown! But how tall are they, really? Let's find out with these little blocks.

intro.speaker: miriam
intro.text: Each block is the same size. Stack them beside a plant until the stack is just as tall as the plant.

older.question: difference
older.prompt: Measure each plant with the blocks. Then we'll compare them.

steps.speaker: miriam
steps.prompt: Stack blocks beside each plant until the stack is just as tall.
steps.question: tallest

feedback.all_good: Yes! Now we know how tall each one is.

outro.speaker: miriam
outro.text: I'll leave a measuring stick by the row. Next week, we can see how much more they've grown.

journal_line: I measured the bean plants with blocks and found the tallest one.
unavailable_text: The beans need to be planted before they can be measured.
